newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polkomtel to cover 60 pct of Poland end '97.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polkomtel to cover 60 pct of Poland end '97.

text.p: Polish digital cellular phone operator Polkomtel SA, which markets its system under the name Plus GSM, expects to cover 60 percent of the country's area by the end of the year, Polkomtel's sales manager said.
In March the company said it covered 40 percent of Poland.
"By the end of the year, 60 percent of the country's area inhabited by 70 percent of the population will by covered by the company's service," Leszek Hajkowski told a news conference on Friday.
"By the end of July Plus GSM had around 200,000 subscribers. Due to launching a new marketing campaign, the number of 200,000 customers should be exceeded," he said.
The company has said that by the end of the century it expects to have more than one million subscribers.

Polkomtel SA, one of Poland's two GSM system operators, is an international consortium which groups Danish Tele Danmark, U.S. AirTouch Communications, Polish copper concern KGHM SA, the Plock oil refinery and the National Power Grid (PSE).
